# @donglegeyu/company-ui

> Enterprise React component library based on Ant Design 6, with custom brand theme (#F95914). 72+ basic components, 14 shared components, 10 business template components. Unified brand tokens, strict usage rules.

## Installation

```bash
npm install @donglegeyu/company-ui
```

Peer dependencies: `antd >=6.0.0`, `react >=16.8.0`, `@ant-design/icons >=5.0.0`.

## Minimal Setup

```tsx
import React from 'react';
import { ThemeProvider, CompanyButton } from '@donglegeyu/company-ui';

export function App() {
  return (
    <ThemeProvider>
      <CompanyButton type="primary">Brand Button</CompanyButton>
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
}
```

## Critical Rules for AI Agents

1. NEVER use antd native components directly. Always use CompanyXxx (e.g. CompanyButton, not Button).
2. NEVER hardcode colors. Use theme.useToken() or designRules constants.
3. NEVER use !important in styles. Use ConfigProvider component-level overrides.
4. NEVER use any type. Define explicit TypeScript interfaces.
5. NEVER use default exports. Always use named exports (export function / export const).
6. ALWAYS prioritize business template components over basic components. For the admin skeleton (sidebar + tabs + content), use AdminLayoutTemplate. For a list page, use SmartListTemplate — do NOT manually assemble CompanyTable + CompanyPagination + CompanyForm. For form pages, use FormPageTemplate. For detail pages, use DetailPageTemplate.
7. The left navigation MUST match the official AdminLayoutTemplate demo: pass `firstMenus` (home + favorites), `systemBottomMenus` (system settings), `homeTab` + `homeContent` as a pair, first-level `businessMenus` icons are OPTIONAL — the sidebar AUTO-MATCHES a built-in icon from the label when `icon` is omitted; pass `icon` (a valid name from the AdminLayoutTemplate icon list, never invented) only when you need a specific one.

### Allowed antd native components (no Company wrapper exists):

`Space`, `Tag`, `Form`, `Row`, `Col`, `Popover`, `Menu`, `App`, `theme` (useToken only), `ConfigProvider` (local overrides only).

### Template priority order (highest first):

1. **Business templates**: AdminLayoutTemplate (admin skeleton) / SmartListTemplate (list) / FormPageTemplate (form) / DetailPageTemplate (detail) / StatisticsListPage — one-shot page solutions
2. **Shared components**: ActionCell / BaseInfoForm / PageTitle / SectionTitle / FormFooterActions — reusable business-level pieces
3. **Basic components**: CompanyTable / CompanyForm / CompanyButton — manual assembly only when templates can't cover the use case

## SmartListTemplate — Minimal Example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Space } from 'antd';
import { SmartListTemplate, CompanyButton, CompanyMessage, ActionCell } from '@donglegeyu/company-ui';
import type { FieldDefinition, ColumnField } from '@donglegeyu/company-ui';

const fields: FieldDefinition[] = [
  { key: 'username', label: '用户名', type: 'input' },
  { key: 'status', label: '状态', type: 'select', options: [
    { label: '已启用', value: 'enabled' },
    { label: '已禁用', value: 'disabled' },
  ]},
  { key: 'createTime', label: '创建时间', type: 'daterange' },
  { key: 'action', label: '操作', type: 'item', width: 180 },
];

const initialColumns: ColumnField[] = [
  { key: 'username', label: '用户名', visible: true, width: 140 },
  { key: 'status', label: '状态', visible: true, width: 100 },
  { key: 'createTime', label: '创建时间', visible: true, width: 160 },
  { key: 'action', label: '操作', visible: true, width: 180 },
];

// NOTE: SmartListTemplate is CONTROLLED — dataSource + pagination props.
// It does NOT have a fetchData prop (that belongs to StatisticsListPage).
const dataSource = [
  { id: 1, username: 'admin', status: 'enabled', createTime: '2024-01-15' },
  { id: 2, username: 'zhangsan', status: 'enabled', createTime: '2024-01-14' },
  { id: 3, username: 'lisi', status: 'disabled', createTime: '2024-01-13' },
];

// SmartListTemplate provides: title + filter form + toolbar (primary buttons + refresh) +
// table + pagination + column settings + view switching
export function UserListPage() {
  const [columnFields, setColumnFields] = useState<ColumnField[]>(initialColumns);
  return (
    <SmartListTemplate
      title="用户列表"
      fields={fields}
      dataSource={dataSource}
      pagination={{ current: 1, pageSize: 10, total: 3 }}
      columnFields={columnFields}
      onColumnSettingsChange={setColumnFields}
      toolbarActions={
        <Space size={12}>
          <CompanyButton type="primary" onClick={() => CompanyMessage.info('新增')}>新增</CompanyButton>
          <CompanyButton onClick={() => CompanyMessage.info('导出')}>导出</CompanyButton>
        </Space>
      }
      onRefresh={(filterParams) => CompanyMessage.success('刷新完成：' + JSON.stringify(filterParams))}
      bodyCell={(column, record) => {
        if (column.key === 'action') {
          return (
            <ActionCell
              buttons={[
                { key: 'edit', label: '编辑', onClick: () => CompanyMessage.info('编辑 ' + record.id) },
                { key: 'delete', label: '删除', confirm: true, confirmTitle: '确定删除？', onClick: () => CompanyMessage.info('删除 ' + record.id) },
              ]}
            />
          );
        }
        return null;
      }}
    />
  );
}
```

⚠️ **Common AI mistakes to avoid**:
- DON'T pass `fetchData` to SmartListTemplate — it has NO such prop. It is controlled: `dataSource` + `onPaginationChange` (fetchData belongs to StatisticsListPage).
- DON'T use `<CompanyInput placeholder="用户名：">` — placeholder is NOT a label. Use FieldDefinition.label or Form.Item label.
- DON'T build `<CompanyTable columns={...} dataSource={...} />` + `<CompanyPagination />` + filter form manually — use SmartListTemplate.
- DON'T use `data.records` — PageResponse field is `data.list`, page number is `pageNum` (antd's `pagination` PROP uses `current` — do not mix the two).

### Slot discipline (titleExtra / toolbarActions / actions...)

Templates expose FIXED extension slots. Put custom content ONLY in these slots — never wrap
extra UI around the template, and never invent slot content the user didn't ask for:

| Slot | Semantics | Allowed content |
|---|---|---|
| titleExtra | extension of the title (status tag, count) | antd `Tag` / `Space` with Tags ONLY when the user's spec mentions counts or status |
| titleRightActions / titleActions | title-bar action area (decoupled from title) | CompanyButton groups |
| toolbarActions / toolbarRightActions | toolbar left/right actions | CompanyButton groups |

Rules:
1. **No self-invented content.** Stat-tag clusters like「共 X 条 / 启用 X / 禁用 X」are CUSTOM extras,
   NOT template built-ins — render them ONLY when the user's requirement explicitly asks for counts.
   Default: pass NO titleExtra at all.
2. Toolbar buttons are CompanyButton with TEXT labels (「新增」「导出」) — plain and consistent with
   the official demos. Do NOT use icon-only buttons, do NOT add dividers/custom spacing around them.
3. Row-level operations use `ActionCell` (`{ key, label, onClick, danger?, confirm? }`) via
   `bodyCell` — never hand-build a `<Space>` of buttons per row. Delete-button STANDARD across
   the library: `confirm: true, confirmTitle: '确定删除？'` WITHOUT `danger` (visually consistent
   with edit/detail; destructive intent is carried by the confirmation).

### Built-in capability ownership (do NOT hand-add)

The docs tell you WHICH component to use; this table tells you which capabilities the components
ALREADY SHIP WITH — pass data/config only, never re-add a layer the library already provides.

| Capability | Already built in | Do NOT hand-add |
|---|---|---|
| Nav icons | SidebarMenuItem auto-matches a built-in icon by `label` keywords (no `icon` needed; fallback folder-open) | `iconNode={<SettingOutlined/>}` — source renders `iconNode || <SvgIcon>`, so an antd icon fully masks the library icon system (mixed fill/line styles) |
| Brand logo | Built-in default logo ships in the package since 1.2.39 | `logo="/logo.svg"` — pass only when the user explicitly wants a custom brand |
| Admin skeleton | AdminLayoutTemplate ships sidebar + tabs + content area | manual CompanySidebar + CompanyMultiTabs assembly (advanced usage only) |
| Content spacing | Templates ship their own padding/background; zero-spacing container is inside AdminLayoutTemplate | padding/margin/background on `contentStyle` or outer wrappers |
| Toolbar buttons | Template toolbars are TEXT-label CompanyButtons | antd icons on CompanyButton |
| Header decorations | The header is managed by the template | self-invented `titleExtra` stat tags unless the user asked for counts |

**Before writing any decoration/icon/extra UI into a business template, ask: does the component
already ship this capability? If yes, pass data/config only.**

## FormPageTemplate — Form Page (USE FOR create/edit pages)

Provides: page title + back arrow + card-wrapped content area + FIXED bottom action bar (submit/cancel).
The form body is schema-driven: `SectionTitle` + `BaseInfoForm` with `FormField[]`.
Do NOT hand-build CompanyForm rows or a bottom button bar — the template already renders them.

### Core Props

| Prop | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| title | string | REQUIRED. Page title |
| showBack / onBack | boolean / () => void | back arrow next to title |
| onSubmit / onCancel | () => void | wired to the fixed bottom bar |
| submitText / cancelText | string | default 提交 / 取消 |
| submitLoading | boolean | submit button loading state |
| footerPosition | 'fixed' \| 'static' | default 'fixed' |
| showFooter / footer | boolean / ReactNode | `footer` overrides the default bar entirely |
| topContent | ReactNode | slot above content (Steps, alerts) |
| contentWrapped | boolean | default true (CompanyCard wrapper); set false for custom content |

### Minimal Example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { FormPageTemplate, SectionTitle, BaseInfoForm } from '@donglegeyu/company-ui';
import type { FormField } from '@donglegeyu/company-ui';

const baseFields: FormField[] = [
  { name: 'name', label: '商品名称', type: 'input', required: true },
  { name: 'category', label: '商品分类', type: 'select', options: [
    { label: '电子产品', value: 'electronics' },
    { label: '服装', value: 'clothing' },
  ]},
  { name: 'price', label: '价格', type: 'input-number' },
];

export function ProductCreatePage() {
  const [data, setData] = useState<Record<string, string | number | boolean | null | undefined>>({});
  return (
    <FormPageTemplate title="新增商品" showBack onSubmit={() => {/* save */}}>
      <SectionTitle title="基础信息" />
      <BaseInfoForm value={data} fields={baseFields} onChange={setData} />
    </FormPageTemplate>
  );
}
```

⚠️ **Common AI mistakes**: hand-assembling `<CompanyCard>` + form fields + a bottom `<Space>` of buttons
re-implements what FormPageTemplate provides — use the template. For grouped forms, repeat
`<SectionTitle title="组名" /> + <BaseInfoForm ... />` pairs inside children.

## DetailPageTemplate — Detail Page (USE FOR view/detail pages)

Provides: title bar (back + avatar + primaryName + tags + actions) + info grid + tab panels.

### Core Props

| Prop | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| title | string | REQUIRED. Page title |
| showBack / onBack | boolean / () => void | back arrow |
| avatar / primaryName | ReactNode | identity block beside the title |
| tags | DetailTagItem[] | status tags next to primaryName |
| infoFields | DetailFieldItem[] | key-value info grid |
| infoColumns | number | grid columns, e.g. 3 |
| tabs | DetailTabItem[] | tab panels below the info grid |
| activeTab / onTabChange | string / (key) => void | controlled tab |
| titleActions | ReactNode | decoupled actions (编辑 / 删除 buttons) |

### Data Contracts

```ts
interface DetailFieldItem { label: string; value: ReactNode }
interface DetailTagItem { text: ReactNode; variant?: 'default' | 'volcano' | 'success' | 'warning' }
interface DetailTabItem { key: string; label: ReactNode; children: ReactNode; disabled?: boolean }
```

### Example (ALL core props: avatar / tags / tabs / titleActions; the 15-row full visual version is in llms-full.txt)

```tsx
import { Row, Col } from 'antd';
import { DetailPageTemplate, CompanyTable, CompanyTag, CompanyButton, SectionTitle } from '@donglegeyu/company-ui';
import type { DetailFieldItem, DetailTagItem, DetailTabItem } from '@donglegeyu/company-ui';

const infoFields: DetailFieldItem[] = [
  { label: '工单编号', value: 'SC20240615001' },
  { label: '燃气编码', value: 'GAS-888234' },
  { label: '客户名称', value: '张三' },
  { label: '联系电话', value: '138****8888' },
  { label: '所属公司', value: '城南燃气分公司' },
  { label: '详细地址', value: '某某小区 12 栋 3 单元 501' },
];
const tags: DetailTagItem[] = [
  { text: '已安检', variant: 'success' },
  { text: '居民用户', variant: 'default' },
  { text: '已上传', variant: 'volcano' },
];
const tabs: DetailTabItem[] = [
  {
    key: 'detail',
    label: '详情',
    children: (
      <div style={{ padding: '0 0 16px' }}>
        <SectionTitle title="个人信息" />
        <Row gutter={[24, 16]}>
          <Col xs={24} sm={12} md={8} lg={6}>出生日期：1985-06-15</Col>
          <Col xs={24} sm={12} md={8} lg={6}>身份证号：3201**********1234</Col>
          <Col xs={24} sm={24} md={24} lg={12}>常住地址：江苏省南京市玄武区中山路100号</Col>
        </Row>
      </div>
    ),
  },
  {
    key: 'result',
    label: '安检结果',
    children: (
      <CompanyTable
        dataSource={[
          { id: 1, projectName: '燃气表检查', status: '合格' },
          { id: 2, projectName: '管道密封性', status: '合格' },
          { id: 3, projectName: '报警器检查', status: '不合格' },
        ]}
        columns={[
          { title: '检查项目', dataIndex: 'projectName' },
          { title: '状态', dataIndex: 'status', render: (text: string) => <CompanyTag>{text}</CompanyTag> },
        ]}
        pagination={false}
        rowKey="id"
      />
    ),
  },
];

export function CheckDetailPage() {
  return (
    <DetailPageTemplate
      title="安检详情"
      showBack
      avatar="张"
      primaryName="张三"
      tags={tags}
      infoFields={infoFields}
      infoColumns={3}
      tabs={tabs}
      titleActions={<CompanyButton type="primary">编辑</CompanyButton>}
    />
  );
}
```

## StatisticsListPage — Statistics List Page (USE FOR stat-cards + table pages)

Provides: statistic cards row + top search + advanced filter drawer + table + pagination.

### Core Props

| Prop | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| columns | StatisticsColumn[] | REQUIRED. Column caption field is `label` — antd's `title` does NOT work |
| fetchData | (params) => Promise<PageResponse<T>> | strict PageResponse contract (`list`, NOT `records`) |
| statisticCards | StatisticCardConfig[] | stat cards row; omit to hide |
| filterFields | StatisticsFilterField[] | advanced filter drawer fields |
| searchKey | string | param name of the top search box, default 'keyword' |
| actionColumn | { width?, title?, render(record, index) } | auto-appends a fixed-right action column |
| onRefresh | (filterParams) => void | shows refresh button when passed |
| defaultPageSize / rowKey / size / scrollY | — | table behavior |

### Data Contracts

```ts
interface StatisticCardConfig { key: string; title: string; value: ReactNode }
interface StatisticsFilterField {
  key: string; label: string; type: 'input' | 'select' | 'date';
  placeholder?: string; options?: { label: string; value: string | number }[];
}
interface StatisticsColumn<T> {
  key: string; label: string; visible?: boolean;
  width?: number; fixed?: 'left' | 'right';
  render?: (record: T, index: number) => ReactNode;
}
```

### Minimal Example

```tsx
import { StatisticsListPage } from '@donglegeyu/company-ui';
import type { StatisticsColumn, StatisticCardConfig, PageResponse } from '@donglegeyu/company-ui';

const statisticCards: StatisticCardConfig[] = [
  { key: 'total', title: '安检总数', value: 1280 },
  { key: 'passed', title: '已通过', value: 1024 },
];
const columns: StatisticsColumn<Record<string, unknown>>[] = [
  { key: 'deviceName', label: '设备名称' },
  { key: 'result', label: '安检结果' },
  { key: 'checkTime', label: '安检时间', width: 180 },
];

export function CheckResultPage() {
  return (
    <StatisticsListPage
      title="安检结果查询"
      statisticCards={statisticCards}
      columns={columns}
      searchKey="keyword"
      fetchData={async (): Promise<PageResponse<Record<string, unknown>>> =>
        ({ list: [], total: 0, pageNum: 1, pageSize: 10 })}
    />
  );
}
```

⚠️ **Common AI mistakes**: using antd-style `title` in StatisticsColumn (use `label`); reading
`data.records` (PageResponse is `list`); hand-building the stat-cards row with CompanyCard.

## Design Tokens

- Brand Primary: #F95914 (vitality orange)
- Disabled Background: #f5f5f5 (pure gray, no blue tint)
- Border Radius: 6px (base)
- Control Height: 32px (base)
- Font Size: 14px (base)
- Full design language: /design.md

## Key Data Contracts

```ts
// Standard API pagination response
interface PageResponse<T> {
  list: T[];       // NOT 'records' or 'dataList'
  total: number;
  pageNum: number;  // NOT 'current' — antd's pagination PROP uses `current`,
  pageSize: number; // but the PageResponse DATA CONTRACT uses `pageNum`. Do not mix.
}

// SmartListTemplate field definition — drives both filter form AND table columns
interface FieldDefinition {
  key: string;
  label: string;       // renders as proper form label (NOT placeholder!)
  type?: 'input' | 'select' | 'date' | 'daterange' | 'item';
  options?: { label: string; value: string | number }[];
  width?: number;
  hideInFilter?: boolean;
  sortable?: boolean;  // opt-in, default false — column-header sorting; NOT part of the default business standard, add only when the page truly needs it
}

// Column settings
interface ColumnField {
  key: string;
  label: string;
  visible: boolean;
  width?: number;
  fixed?: 'left' | 'right';
}
```


## AdminLayoutTemplate — Admin Skeleton (USE THIS FIRST)

The admin skeleton (left sidebar + top tabs + content area) is FIXED into ONE component.
Do NOT manually assemble CompanySidebar + CompanyMultiTabs — tab state, menu highlight sync,
and the spacing contract are all managed internally.

### Core Props (~7 required for a working skeleton)

| Prop | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| logo | string | NO (built-in default) | Logo image path. Since `@donglegeyu/company-ui@1.2.39` a default logo ships INSIDE the package (data URI, zero network) — omit `logo` entirely and the built-in brand logo renders. Pass the project's own logo path to override; pass `logo=""` to force the brandName first-letter fallback. NEVER copy "/logo-dl.svg" from the docs demos — that asset lives on the docs site only and 404s in real projects. |
| brandName | string | YES | Brand name, e.g. "物资管理系统" |
| domains | SidebarDomain[] | YES | Business domain dropdown data |
| businessMenus | SidebarMenuItem[] | YES | Full business menu tree (drives "more apps" drawer + second-level menu) |
| userInfo | SidebarUserInfo | YES | User info card (bottom-left) |
| onLogout | () => void | YES | Logout callback |
| pages | AdminLayoutPageItem[] | YES* | Page config: key/label/component — clicking a menu auto-opens tab and renders component |
| onDomainChange | (domain: SidebarDomain) => void | recommended | Domain switch callback (re-fetch menus here) |

Advanced props (tabs / activeTabKey / defaultActiveKey / favorites / customNavMenus...) are all OPTIONAL —
the component manages tab state internally: clicking a menu opens/activates a tab automatically,
closing a tab switches to the neighbor. Pass controlled props only when you need routing sync.

### Nav-Structure Props (optional — defaults already match the official demo)

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| firstMenus | SidebarMenuItem[] | Home + Favorites | leftmost icon rail (first-level quick menus) |
| systemBottomMenus | SidebarMenuItem[] | System Settings | icons pinned to the bottom of the icon rail |
| visibleMenuCount | number | 6 | max visible first-level business menus; extras collapse into the "more apps" drawer |
| customNavMenus | SidebarMenuItem[] | businessMenus.slice(0, visibleMenuCount) | controlled quick-nav; pass only to persist user edits |
| homeTab / homeContent | MultiTabHomeConfig / ReactNode | - | home tab config + its content (recommended: pass both together) |

If the generated navigation differs from the official demo, check these props FIRST —
e.g. more than 6 business menus collapses extras into the "more apps" drawer by default,
and omitting homeTab/homeContent leaves the "Home" icon without a landing tab.

### Minimal Admin Skeleton Example

**GOAL: the left navigation MUST look exactly like the official AdminLayoutTemplate demo.**
Copy this navigation scaffold verbatim and only rename key/label/path/children. The icon rail
(Home / Favorites / business icons / bottom System Settings) is decided by `firstMenus` +
`systemBottomMenus` + `businessMenus[].icon` together — miss any one and the nav differs from the demo.

```tsx
import { AdminLayoutTemplate, SmartListTemplate, CompanyMessage } from '@donglegeyu/company-ui';
import type { SidebarDomain, SidebarMenuItem, SidebarUserInfo, FieldDefinition } from '@donglegeyu/company-ui';

const domains: SidebarDomain[] = [{ id: 1, domainName: '华东大区' }];
const userInfo: SidebarUserInfo = { id: 1, username: 'admin', nickname: '系统管理员' };

// demo-parity icon rail (pass explicitly — do not rely on defaults)
const firstMenus: SidebarMenuItem[] = [
  { key: 'home', label: '首页', icon: 'home' },
  { key: 'favorites', label: '收藏', icon: 'favorites' },
];
// demo-parity bottom fixed menu
const systemBottomMenus: SidebarMenuItem[] = [
  { key: 'system-settings', label: '系统设置', icon: 'setting' },
];

// icon is OPTIONAL: omitted icons AUTO-MATCH by label. Explicit here to mirror the demo:
// otherwise the rail renders without icons and differs from the demo
const businessMenus: SidebarMenuItem[] = [
  { key: 'user', label: '用户管理', icon: 'people-top-card', children: [
    { key: 'user-list', label: '用户列表', path: '/user/list' },
  ] },
  { key: 'role', label: '角色权限', icon: 'config', children: [
    { key: 'role-list', label: '角色列表', path: '/role/list' },
  ] },
  { key: 'dept', label: '部门管理', icon: 'category-management', children: [
    { key: 'dept-list', label: '部门列表', path: '/dept/list' },
  ] },
];
const fields: FieldDefinition[] = [
  { key: 'username', label: '用户名', type: 'input' },
  { key: 'action', label: '操作', type: 'item', width: 180 },
];

export function AdminPage() {
  return (
    <AdminLayoutTemplate
      style={{ height: '100vh' }}
      // logo 可省略：@1.2.39+ 内置默认 Logo（随包 data URI）；传项目自己的路径覆盖；传 "" 回退品牌名首字母
      brandName="物资管理系统"
      domains={domains}
      firstMenus={firstMenus}
      systemBottomMenus={systemBottomMenus}
      businessMenus={businessMenus}
      userInfo={userInfo}
      onLogout={() => CompanyMessage.info('退出登录')}
      onDomainChange={(d) => console.log('switch domain', d.domainName)}
      homeTab={{ key: 'home', label: '首页' }}
      homeContent={<div style={{ padding: 24, fontSize: 14 }}>首页</div>}
      pages={[
        { key: 'user-list', label: '用户列表', path: '/user/list',
          component: <SmartListTemplate title="用户列表" fields={fields} dataSource={[]} /> },
      ]}
    />
  );
}
```

Demo-parity nav checklist (self-check after generating):
1. Icon rail top-to-bottom: logo/brand → domain → Home(home) → Favorites(favorites) → business icons
   (max `visibleMenuCount=6` visible, extras in the "more apps" drawer) → System Settings(setting) → user card
2. First-level `businessMenus` items do NOT need `icon` — the sidebar AUTO-MATCHES a built-in icon by label keywords (用户→people-top-card, 商品→commodity, 订单→order, fallback folder-open). Pass `icon` only to override
3. `homeTab` + `homeContent` passed as a pair (clicking Home opens a landing tab)
4. NEVER invent icon names — a made-up name renders as blank (fallback needs the full sprite loaded)

Valid icon names — the SvgIcon built-in (curated) dictionary, 61 icons total (verified against the
icon-library module at /icon-library; names are EXACT, never invent your own — an unknown name
falls back to the full sprite and renders BLANK unless the sprite is loaded):

Nav & system (13): `home` `setting` `logout` `favorites` `star` `star-fill` `pin` `pushpin` `bookmark` `tag` `config` `tool` `radar`
Business (18): `people-top-card` `doc-search` `order` `shopping-cart-del` `buy` `commodity` `file-cabinet` `message-security` `comments` `table` `box` `database-config` `wallet` `scan-setting` `category-management` `user-positioning` `all-application` `folder-open`
Actions (17): `search` `edit` `writing-fluently` `more-one` `more` `more-three` `check-one` `close` `add-one` `minus-one` `delete-two` `save` `preview-open` `preview-close-one` `copy` `zoom-in` `zoom-out`
Layout (8): `drag` `density` `more-app` `hamburger-button` `waterfalls-h` `list` `pic` `equalizer`
Arrows (5): `down` `up` `left` `right` `refresh`

For first-level businessMenus icons prefer: `people-top-card` (user mgmt) / `config` (role/perm) /
`category-management` (dept/taxonomy) / `box` / `order` / `buy` / `commodity` / `file-cabinet` /
`table` / `doc-search` / `database-config` / `wallet` / `comments` / `folder-open` / `radar` / `tool`.
The full 2658-icon IconPark library is only available via `href` + loaded sprite — do NOT use
those names as `icon` in menus.

That is ALL. No manual tab state, no menu highlight sync, no content wrapper —
the zero-spacing content wrapper is built into the component.

### Data Contracts (used by AdminLayoutTemplate props)

#### SidebarDomain
```ts
interface SidebarDomain {
  id: number | string;
  domainName: string;   // WARNING: field is 'domainName', NOT 'name'!
}
```

#### SidebarMenuItem (used for businessMenus / firstMenus / systemBottomMenus)
```ts
interface SidebarMenuItem {
  key: string;
  label: string;
  path?: string;
  icon?: string;         // SvgIcon sprite name, e.g. 'home' / 'box' / 'setting'
  iconNode?: React.ReactNode;
  children?: SidebarMenuItem[];
}
```

#### SidebarUserInfo
```ts
interface SidebarUserInfo {
  id?: number | string;
  username?: string;
  nickname?: string;
  realName?: string;
  avatar?: string;
}
```

#### SidebarFavoriteItem
```ts
interface SidebarFavoriteItem {
  menuKey: string;
  menuLabel: string;
  menuPath?: string;
  sort?: number;
}
```

#### MultiTabItem
```ts
interface MultiTabItem {
  key: string;
  label: React.ReactNode;
  path?: string;
  closable?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
}
```

WARNING: Common AI mistakes when generating admin skeleton:
- Manually assembling CompanySidebar + CompanyMultiTabs -> use AdminLayoutTemplate instead. Manual assembly is ADVANCED usage only (when you need fully custom layout).
- Missing `brandName` -> top-left brand area renders blank. `logo` is OPTIONAL since 1.2.39 (built-in default) — do NOT pass a logo path unless the user explicitly wants a custom brand
- Missing `domains` -> business domain dropdown is empty
- Missing `businessMenus` -> "more apps" drawer is empty
- Missing `onLogout` -> logout entry is missing
- Using `SidebarDomain.name` -> should be `domainName`
- Adding padding/margin/background to AdminLayoutTemplate content (contentStyle) -> DOUBLE SPACING. Business templates have built-in padding and background.
